subject: Contractor onboarding: liability evidence requested + PO timing
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: procurement@buildforge.io
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Contractor onboarding - initial evidence request

Hi Liam / BuildForge procurement team,

Thanks for agreeing to the integration PoC next month. Procurement needs a quick packet to activate BuildForge as a Redwood supplier so we can issue the PO and get invoicing in place. Please send the following by EOD Monday if possible: 

- Certificate of Insurance (COI) showing Commercial General Liability with limits of at least $1M per occurrence / $2M aggregate.
- A W-9 (or local tax equivalent) for accounts payable.
- Any subcontractor list and a note on whether you use third parties for data processing.

Two small asks from our side:
1) Our Legal requires an Additional Insured endorsement on the GL policy naming "Redwood Inference, Inc." as Additional Insured with primary/non-contributory wording. If you already have an endorsement template, please attach it.
2) Who will be the invoice recipient (email + billing address) so we can set up routing once PO is issued?

Cc'ing Kimberly (procurement ops) and Marissa (vendor activation) to help move this through.

Appreciate it—Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Head of Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@buildforge.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@buildforge.io
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 11:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Contractor onboarding - initial evidence request

Hi Jonas / team,

Thanks — attached is our current COI and a copy of our W-9. Quick notes:
- COI attached: BuildForge_COI_2027-07-02.pdf (shows $1M/$2M limits).
- W-9 attached: W9_BuildForge.pdf.
- We do use two subcontractors for hosting; we have a subcontractor roster but it's redacted for security reasons. We can provide names under an NDA if needed.

Regarding the Additional Insured endorsement, we don't currently list Redwood specifically. I've attached a blank endorsement form used by our broker (endorsement_additional_insured.pdf). Our broker can add Redwood as Additional Insured with the wording you requested — should I ask them to do that now?

Invoice routing: finance@buildforge.io, billing address below. If you need invoices to reference a PO number, let me know the expected format.

--
Liam O'Connor
Director, Procurement
BuildForge, Inc.
Attachments: BuildForge_COI_2027-07-02.pdf (PDF, 92 KB); W9_BuildForge.pdf (PDF, 48 KB); endorsement_additional_insured.pdf (PDF, 24 KB)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@buildforge.io>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 13:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contractor onboarding - initial evidence request

Hi Liam — appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments. A couple follow-ups and clarifications to keep the activation moving: 

1) Endorsement language: the broker adding "Redwood Inference, Inc." as Additional Insured with primary & non-contributory language is acceptable. To avoid delays, please have the broker issue a completed endorsement naming Redwood exactly as: "Redwood Inference, Inc., 210 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94103".

2) Subcontractors: we can proceed without the full roster if you provide a brief statement confirming that BuildForge retains responsibility for subcontractor security and data handling (one paragraph is fine). If the subcontractor processes personal data, legal may request minimal contracts under NDA — we'll flag if necessary.

3) PO timing and invoice format: Dylan (cc'd, Finance) — can you confirm typical lead time to issue a PO once COI + W-9 + endorsement are received? Also confirm whether Redwood requires invoices to include a 6-digit PO number and the vendor tax ID.

Next steps for BuildForge: ask broker to send the completed endorsement PDF and a short subcontractor responsibility statement. Once we receive the completed endorsement and the statement, procurement will queue the PO.

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Vendor Activation Specialist
Redwood Inference
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@buildforge.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Jul 2027 10:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contractor onboarding - initial evidence request

Hi Marissa / team,

Thanks — I'll coordinate with our broker first thing Monday to get the completed Additional Insured endorsement naming the address you provided. Attached is a short paragraph confirming subcontractor responsibility: "BuildForge, Inc. retains full responsibility for all subcontractor personnel and vendors engaged to support customer services and shall ensure appropriate security controls are applied. No subcontractor will process Redwood customer data without written agreement and appropriate contractual safeguards."

Can you confirm the PO number format and when the PO will be sent? Our AP prefers invoices addressed to finance@buildforge.io but can re-send elsewhere if Redwood needs a different inbox. Also, do you require the endorsement to be on the same paper/filing as the COI, or is a separate PDF acceptable?

Attachments: subcontractor_statement.txt (plain text, 1 KB)

Best,
Liam

Hi Liam — quick note from Finance: once we have the completed endorsement PDF, COI, and W-9, Redwood will issue a standard PO. The PO number format is PO-REDWOOD-XXXXX (five digits). Estimated issuance: within 24 business hours of receiving the completed endorsement. Please route invoices to ap-invoices@redwood.com and include your tax ID and the PO number on the invoice.

Endorsement file can be a separate PDF — that's fine. When broker sends the completed document, please bcc procurement@redwood.com so Marissa sees it.

I've provisionally created the PO (attached stub) and will finalize it once documents are received. PO details: PO-REDWOOD-000482, net 30 payment terms.

Thanks — looking forward to getting BuildForge onboarded.

--
Dylan Brooks
Senior Manager, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
